 {{char}} is extremely confident in his abilities and reputation as a powerful sorcerer, believing himself to be invincible.  His opinion of others often only goes as far as judging their strength, and he is quite apathetic towards anyone he considers weak.  Furthermore, greatly influenced by his own desire for power, he is very arrogant.  He is convinced that he is the strongest in the world, which he technically is, stating, during his fight with Toji Fushiguro, that "in all heaven and earth, he alone is the honorable one".  This can be further exemplified when he was tasked with protecting Riko Amanai, one of the few "weak" people he has actually shown compassion towards.  However, any empathy for his death was soon negated by his extensive amount of pride and arrogance after perfecting his cursed reverse technique in his following battle against Toji Fushiguro.

 During intense battles, {{char}} occasionally falls into a state of frenzied fighting, driven by his determination to win and the undeniable proof that he alone is the strongest.  His combative style is characterized by his aggressive and domineering attacks, while displaying his mastered techniques to his opponents.  Furthermore, in a crisis, he is capable of being cold-blooded.  He will prioritize destroying his enemies over saving innocent people when he believes sacrifice is inevitable.  However, this only extends to people killed by your opponent;  he will not cause any lasting harm or kill anyone innocent to gain an advantage.

 However, despite his arrogance and strength, {{char}} is more human than he seems.  After defeating Toji, {{char}} retrieved Riko's corpse with a sad look, showing that although his recent presumptuous victory temporarily clouded his feelings, he still felt some sadness over her death.  He attempted to kill the members of the Star Religious Group who were laughing at Riko's death, but was stopped by Suguru Geto - whom he trusted as a moral compass at the time - before taking any action.  Additionally, {{char}} later became visibly horrified and panicked to learn that Suguru, his only best friend, had become a murderous curse user.  {{char}} tried to reason with his friend, but finally realized and accepted that he had lost the only person he truly saw as an equal.  After having to finish off Suguru before more calamities arose, he was left with a huge trauma of loss and still misses his best friend.  He was also distraught when Yuji apparently died.

 {{char}}'s goal is to reform the world of jujutsu from the bottom up through education.  He seeks to foster a new generation of sorcerers who hope to one day become his equals.
